title: atractocarpus hirtus
intro: Atractocarpus hirtus, commonly known as the hairy atractocarpus, is a species of flowering plant in the family Staphyladaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine and is known for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which help to alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Atractocarpus hirtus include its ability to reduce inflammation, fight off infections, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
